Kimberly's intake checklist (first pass):
- Counterparty MSA received (FastPulse_MSA_v1.docx) — scope: standard SaaS + API consumption.
- Major redline flags to watch for: broad liability caps, residuals language, overly broad audit/data inspection clauses, and cross-license IP carveouts.
- Residency: US-only production is fine; verify whether backup replicas travel outside US and document in Exhibit D.
- SOC 2 status: Not available yet — request written timeline and interim controls summary; Ops should collect questionnaire and any relevant security docs.

Action items:
1) Kimberly to produce an initial redline (we will mark priority clauses) — target: 5 business days from receipt of counterparty MSA (EOD Wed 9/2).
2) Marissa to create billing/contact exhibit and record Nina Lopez as primary.
3) Rachel to confirm signing party and schedule kickoff 9/2 at 10am PT if Sarah confirms.

I also exported a quick mapping of key FastPulse clauses to Redwood's standard template — attaching as stub: Redwood_Template_Mapping.xlsx.
